disagreements.answer: Yes, both Roger Waters and Tom Johnston are musicians. Roger Waters is a drummer, and Tom Johnston is a guitarist.
disagreements.question: Are Roger Waters and Tom Johnston both musicians?
disagreements.judge_reason: While it correctly answers yes to the question, it adds a material factual error: Roger Waters is a bassist/vocalist, not a drummer.

disagreements.answer: Chimaja Appawas was the younger brother of Chimaji Appa, a general of the Maratha Empire in India. Chimaja Appawas served as the Peshwa (prime minister) to the fifth Maratha Chhatrapati Shahu from 1720 until his death.
disagreements.question: Chimaja Appawas the younger brother of a general of the Maratha Empire in India, who served as what to the fifth Maratha Chhatrapati Shahu from 1720 until his death?
disagreements.judge_reason: The answer correctly names 'Peshwa (prime minister)' but misattributes the role to Chimaja Appa. Historically, the Peshwa to Chhatrapati Shahu from 1720 until his death (1740) was Bajirao I (Chimaji Appa's brother), not Chimaja Appa. This is a material factual error, so the answer is incorrect despite containing the right title.

disagreements.question: Who succeeded Prince Rainier of Monaco?
disagreements.judge_reason: The proposed answer 'Prince Albert II' does not match any of the supplied reference answers. All reference answers refer to Prince Albert, the 19th-century Prince Consort of the United Kingdom (of Saxe-Coburg-Gotha), not Albert II of Monaco who succeeded Rainier III. Since the answer is not semantically equivalent to any valid reference answer, it is incorrect.
